summary.text: Rob LaClair is a Republican candidate for the Vermont State Senate in the Washington District in the November 3, 2026 general election and a former state representative who served in the Vermont House from 2015 to 2023.

paragraphs.text: Rob LaClair represented the Washington-2 District in the Vermont House of Representatives, assuming office on January 7, 2015, and leaving office on January 4, 2023, after he did not file to run for re-election in 2022.

Ballotpedia lists his committee assignments in 2021 and 2022 as the Legislative Management, Government Operations (ranking member) and Rules committees, and in 2023 and 2024 as Government Operations and Rules.
He advanced from the August 11, 2026 Republican primary to the general election for the Washington District Senate seats.
